descriptor: Hydration brand with a fill-up loader

voice.summary: Brookline Water sounds like a cool glass on a hot day: clear, simple and quietly encouraging. Short sentences make a point about drinking enough without nagging.
dos: Use short, clear sentences about water and levels
donts: Use wellness hype or health claims
Use aquatic puns on every line

boilerplate: Brookline Water is a hydration brand that helps people drink enough through simple reminders, a visual fill gauge and bottles designed to be refilled.

microcopy.error: Could not update your level. Try again.
microcopy.empty: Your glass is empty. Start filling.

logo.note: A water drop is the clearest symbol for a hydration brand.
